CharacterStyleRange.Content: 21. Notes to the Statement of Cash Flows

For the purpose of the statement of cash flows, cash and cash equivalents includes cash on hand and in banks, net of outstanding bank overdrafts. Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the financial period as shown in the statement of cash flows is reconciled to the related items in the statement of financial position as follows:
(b) Reconciliation of net profit to net cash (used in) operating activities
Depreciation and amortisation of non-current assets
Changes in net assets and liabilities:
Net cash used in operating activities
